{"entries":[{"content":{"appGalleryLabel":{"content":{"categoryID":"Deployment_Category_a38388ef-e836-434d-87c7-bd36217bf926","labelID":"Deployment_ToolboxAppGalleryFiles_a38388ef-e836-434d-87c7-bd36217bf926"},"type":"deployment.toolbox.model.ProjectLabel","uuid":"e92af48d-6497-498b-9e12-7bcaf7b48aca"},"authorEmail":"ce20323@bristol.ac.uk","authorName":"Matthew Richardson","authorOrganization":"University of Bristol","description":"The tool integrates with Mach4 and Pokeys systems and supports STL/STEP input, multi-axis toolpaths, and custom cutting logic.

🚀 Features
Import STL and STEP files
Generate 2D and 3D toolpaths for hot-wire cutting
Adjustable cut parameters (speed, offsets, alignment)
Toolpath visualisation inside MATLAB
Exports G-code compatible with Mach4
Modular code structure for easy maintenance
📂 Project Structure
/src → Main MATLAB code
/helpers → Utility functions
/examples → Sample geometry files
/docs → Project documentation
/data → CAD models for testing

🛠 Requirements
MATLAB R2021a or later
FreeCAD (v1.0 or newer) - Required for importing .STEP files.
Optional:
Image Processing Toolbox (for previews)
Curve Fitting Toolbox (for smoothing)
▶️ How to Run
Clone the repository: git clone https://github.com/ce20323/GitRepo_CNCHotWire_Gcode_App.git

Add the folder to the MATLAB path: addpath(genpath('GitRepo_CNCHotWire_Gcode_App'));

Run the main script (replace "main" with your actual start file): main

🔧 Development Workflow
main → stable code
